characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production expression sprite sheet for a Taiwanese mahjong game. Draw a cohesive hand-painted 1990s Japanese TV anime cel animation character, thin confident dark ink outlines, angular tapered chin, expressive classic 90s eyes, crisp two-tone cel shadows, solid graphic hair highlight shapes, warm slightly muted cel pigments. Not chibi, not 3D, not modern glossy mobile-game rendering. Original character.
Layout CRITICAL: landscape 1536x1024, exact invisible 3-column by 2-row grid, six equal square cells, each 512x512. Put the SAME character in the first FIVE cells, last bottom-right cell completely empty transparent. Transparent background for entire sheet, no panels, no borders, no text, no labels, no effects outside character silhouette. Each portrait entirely inside its cell with generous 35px transparent safety margin, all hair and shoulders contained, no overlap; head-and-shoulders framing with large readable face, top of hair at local y=40, eyes near local y=235, shoulders to y=475, centered local x=256. Consistent scale, face geometry, clothes and hairstyle across all five.
Expressions in reading order: top-left NORMAL (eyes open, composed gentle smile); top-middle HAPPY (eyes happily closed, broad laughing smile); top-right SURPRISED (wide open eyes, raised brows, small open O mouth); bottom-left SAD (downturned mouth, worried eyebrows, dejected eyes); bottom-middle WIN (confident triumphant grin, one eye winking). No hands, props, words, symbols or watermarks. Modest fully clothed shoulders.
